description: This file implements a tensor renormalization operation optimized for Apple Metal Performance Shaders (MPS). It defines the core function 'renorm_out_mps' which computes vector norms and applies renormalization on tensors using GPU acceleration through Metal APIs. The file includes setting up shader pipelines, managing buffers, and invoking GPU kernels, and it exposes the operation via a PyTorch implementation macro.

classes.name: MPSStream
classes.description: Class managing the Metal command queue and encoding operations.

methods.name: renorm_out_mps
methods.description: Performs the renormalization operation on a tensor 'self' using GPU acceleration, computing vector norms and applying a maximum norm constraint, outputting to 'out'.
